purpose: Therapeutic-priority queue for CrystalProbe measurement and curation. This is not medical advice and not a verified benchmark manifest.

priority_groups.rationale: ADHD medications are societally important and solid-form behavior is directly relevant to reliable manufacturing, storage, and formulation.

targets.name: atomoxetine hydrochloride
known_public_evidence: stable and metastable polymorphic forms reported in Journal of Pharmaceutical Sciences, DOI 10.1002/jps.20643
commercial atomoxetine HCl powder-diffraction structure reported in Powder Diffraction, DOI 10.1017/S0885715614000517
targets.next_action: Locate redistributable CIFs or request CCDC/API-compatible access, then create verified pair candidate if licenses permit.

targets.name: methylphenidate hydrochloride
known_public_evidence: PubChem CID 9280 records crystalline methylphenidate hydrochloride identity and salt form.
targets.next_action: Search CSD/open patent/literature sources for polymorph or solid-form CIFs before benchmark inclusion.

targets.name: lisdexamfetamine dimesylate
known_public_evidence: PubChem CID 11597697 records the dimesylate salt identity.
targets.next_action: Search for solid-form structures and license-compatible CIF access.

targets.name: modafinil
targets.role: wakefulness-promoting medication sometimes studied near ADHD workflows
known_public_evidence: metastable polymorph structure reported in Crystal Growth & Design, DOI 10.1021/cg030069t
targets.next_action: Review whether the available forms and licensing support a benchmark pair.
